name: Spicy Beef & Green Chile Cheese Fries with Cilantro

instructions.primary_message: FOR THE FRIES: Preheat oven to 450°F.

Once the oven is heated, arrange fries on a large baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer. Place in the oven and bake, tossing once, until golden brown and crispy, about 20 minutes (or cook according to package instructions).
instructions.secondary_message: 1 (793 g) bag steak cut French fries, frozen

instructions.primary_message: FOR THE SPICY BEEF: Meanwhile, preheat a large pot over medium heat.
While the pot heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion.
Once the pot is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and beef; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp butter, unsalted
454 g lean ground beef

instructions.primary_message: Add tomato sauce, broth, tomato paste, and spices to the pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the chili has thickened, 10-15 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
213 ml tomato sauce
½ cup beef broth
2 tbsp tomato paste
1 tsp chili powder
1 tsp salt
½ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp cumin, ground
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: FOR THE GREEN CHILE CHEESE SAUCE: While the chili is cooking, preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Once the pan is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add flour and cook, whisking frequently, for 1 minute.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp butter, unsalted
2 tbsp all-purpose flour

instructions.primary_message: Slowly pour half & half and milk into the pan, whisking constantly. Continue to cook, whisking frequently, until the sauce has thickened, 4-5 minutes more.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cups half & half
½ cup whole milk

instructions.primary_message: Add cheese, green chilies, and spices to the pan. Cook, whisking frequently, until cheese is melted and sauce is smooth, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (113 g) can diced green chiles, canned
½ tsp chili powder
½ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
To serve, transfer crispy fries to a serving platter; top with cheese sauce, chili, and cilantro. Enjoy!
